card.name: Ends of table cell entries
card.fires_on: The last piece of an entry in a flattened table or header, just before the next column starts. Often a final digit in (n=484), an abbreviation like (ABSSSI) or (aPTT), or a closing word before a parenthesis.

modes.label: Digits in sample sizes
modes.description: Final digit of an n= or N= count in a table header or row.

modes.label: Closing abbreviations
modes.description: Last letters of a bracketed abbreviation or label in a table heading.

modes.label: Header file extension
modes.description: Extension at the end of an include line in a manual page.

card.writes: It suppresses markdown and list-marker tokens, so it adds little beyond keeping the table text flowing.
card.plain: It fires at the very end of a table cell entry, right before the next column or row begins.
